capabilities: Surface pause-triggered related notes around the cursor as internal links
Show an expandable reinvention nudge with the matched snippet and context
Provide a thinking panel with Socratic questions, tensions, and selection recall
Rank stale-but-relevant notes above recently touched ones by forgetting curve
Drag or copy related notes into the editor without ever writing the vault
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly true). Networking is strictly opt-in and goes only to the configured endpoint; the engine has no built-in authentication and relies on Tailscale network trust, so the README warns to never point it at a public URL. Manual build and install only.
problem: While writing, Obsidian only shows relations you already linked; there is no way to surface semantically related or stale-but-relevant notes and near-duplicate ideas as you pause.

relations.evidence: The companion is a read-only client — it has nothing to talk to on its own.

requires.name: hypermnesic engine (leonardsellem/hypermnesic), self-hosted and reached over Tailscale

summary: Read-only companion that surfaces pause-triggered related notes and a reinvention nudge from a self-hosted hypermnesic index over MCP on your tailnet.
